name: The Bureau of Lost Gusts
prompt: Line up windsocks with openings as broad as doors, from taut scarlet silk to a limp striped sleeve. Collectors bottle the passing gusts in little bellows, then carry them to a rack of waiting toy windmills.

name: The Rain Abacus
prompt: Make a giant upright abacus of clear tubes on a black frame. Rain entering each tube floats its coloured bead to a different height. Weather readers cross a low gantry sliding fine brass markers up to yesterday's levels.

name: The Cloud Printing Bed
prompt: Set blue fabric sheets on a long sloping lawn. Cloud shadows expose the cloth to sunlight for different lengths of time. Attendants lift a finished sheet and reveal a pale, ragged cloud portrait hanging between two poles.

name: A Barograph Big Enough to Walk
prompt: Wind a wide white paper strip around a slowly turning timber drum. A red pencil lever as long as a footbridge traces the pressure. Meteorologists walk along the lever to inspect a sudden kink in the line.

name: The Forecast Kitchen
prompt: Arrange copper pans of increasing diameter above a low brick hearth. Each pan boils at a different pressure under a weighted glass lid. A cook raises a black storm flag when the lightest lid begins to dance.
